_metadata.description: Gold benchmark (roadmap 1.10) for interaction-subject reachability: real DSLD label rows through the production enricher must reach the interaction rules their chemistry names.
_metadata.expectation_basis: must_fire lists the rules authored on the ingredient the label row chemically is (chosen from the label, before the enricher ran). must_not_fire pins false-severe controls: a form-scoped or provitamin rule that a different form must not inherit.
_metadata.input_boundary: Each active_ingredients row is the cleaner's verbatim output row for a real DSLD label. The enricher is not given any expected value.
